articles.summary: In a landmark move, four eminent organisations have united under a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU). This alliance aims to digitise and certify Bhutan's treasured Sowa-Rigpa, the ancient Traditional Medicines known for its complex diagnostic techniques and use of natural herbs.
articles.title: Preserving Tradition in the Digital Age: A Historic Collaboration for Digitising Bhutan's Medicinal Plants and Herbs
